content: Ananya inquired whether the reinstatement fee offered for her health policy was the best rate; Vikram confirmed it was the best available. She asked how long reactivation would take after payment, and he explained it typically takes 3–5 business days, promising to expedite. Ananya agreed to pay the fee today and requested information on any additional documents needed.
